comment: Spec 055 §9.3 conformance mapping for TS-0 and TS-1U/TS-1D (049 decision 9), unit 055-t17. Each criterion of 049 (C0 contracts, C0A content path and privacy gate, C1 emitters and projection) names the tests that hold it for the TypeScript wire capture, as `path::title` (a test, a describe block or a Python test function); scripts/tests/test_node_wire_qualification_claim.py checks every name exists. TS-1H rows and LR-1 are unit 055-t22's; no TS-2/P2/P3 or 046 conformance is claimed.

tests: sdk/typescript/test/wire/manifest/fixtures.test.ts::the fixtures themselves pass the same validator
sdk/typescript/test/wire/config/config.test.ts::every FW- literal in src/wire is a TypeScript catalogue entry
sdk/typescript/test/wire/status/status.test.ts::every typescript catalogue entry is emitted by some code path

C0-3.means: pseudonym vectors (v1 unchanged, v2 domain separation)

tests: sdk/typescript/test/wire/protect/parity.test.ts::the role table and fabric.local-default equal Python's
sdk/typescript/test/wire/parts/split.test.ts::retains the parts with half-open ranges and reassembles to source_sha256

C0A-2.means: privacy canaries on telemetry, spool, logs and reports
tests: sdk/typescript/test/wire/parts/split.test.ts::property: retained splits reassemble; protecting modes never leak
sdk/typescript/test/wire/protect/protect.test.ts::a production policy makes a local store production; a local one needs no keys

C0A-4.means: caller-id mapping; the Node rejects clear ids under a pseudonymous configuration
tests: sdk/typescript/test/wire/run/scope.test.ts::no clear caller id reaches any marker, seal or token in the pseudonymous mode
sdk/typescript/test/wire/run/identity.test.ts::a pseudonymous consumer refuses a clear correlation id (R8); a clear one takes it
sdk/typescript/test/wire/ts0/ts0.test.ts::clear mode emits the caller's ids as given (the explicit opt-in)

C1-1.means: event id stable across retry and re-export
tests: sdk/typescript/test/wire/sender/sender.test.ts::restart: what a killed process admitted is delivered by the next one with the same ids and bytes
sdk/typescript/test/wire/seal/pipeline.test.ts::replay unchanged: every read, in TypeScript and in Python, gives the minted id

C1-3.means: projection schema; the same exchanges reconstruct identically

tests: sdk/typescript/test/wire/parts/large.test.ts::a 40 MiB request with one inline image keeps its text and reassembles to source_sha256
sdk/typescript/test/wire/parts/scan.test.ts::covers the shared fixture's edge cases and seeded random bodies
sdk/typescript/test/wire/undici/publisher.test.ts::a matched call another undici copy publishes is an uninstrumented_client loss
sdk/typescript/test/wire/ledger/ledger.test.ts::a torn slot is cleared and counted, never exported, and reported by both drainers
